body.intent: Fix Accepting a change set from the Inbox app never reaches the run that builds it. On 2026-11-06 the owner accepted Import procedure (01M6J36X) in the Inbox app at 14:31:10Z; the accept entry was written to the main clone's .rhiza/log but stayed uncommitted and unpushed. The daemon started the ship-change run 11 s later on a branch from origin, without the entry, and the run built, passed review and CI, then failed at land: 'cannot ship change set 01M6J36X...: it is proposed, not accepted' (the orchestrator copied the entry onto the run branch by hand to get it merged as #328). An accept from the Inbox app (and rhiza accept on the main clone generally) must reach the run's branch, e.g. by committing and pushing the accept to main or by the run carrying it, so the run never sees an accepted change set as proposed.
